generate_gmock_classes: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes
generate_gmock_for_class: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header with a specific class name to generate a mock for that class
generate_methods_from_ast: call _GenerateMethods to produce MOCK_METHOD macro lines for virtual functions in a parsed C++ class AST node
generate_mocks_from_source: call _GenerateMocks to produce full mock class definitions from a C++ source AST including namespaces and templates
review_gmock_class_generator: review the gmock_class.py script to understand how it parses C++ headers and generates Google Mock classes
